column1: # #move - side changes after the books (CanonCompanionsFollowStory). Rows of one character run in file order; a row waits until the earlier rows of the
# same character are done; an earlier row whose trigger has not come yet is dropped when a later one fires (the story went past it).
# who: ROTwanderer* = the character made from that template (no parents); any other id = Hero.StringId (ROT lords, e.g. ROTlord_177 Jeyne Westerling).
# trigger: terms joined by | (any of them); a term may end with +N = N days after it first came true:
#   ev:<ROT event> started (IsActive or done), done:<ROT event> finished (ROT.Events.*: NedEvent, RenlyDeathEvent, BlackwaterSiegeEvent, BlackwaterEvent,
#   RedWeddingEvent, JoffreyEvent = Purple Wedding, RamsayEvent, JonEvent, WallEvent, HarrenhalSiegeNotificationEvent, RickardKarstarkExecutionEvent,
#   AegonInvasionEvent, DanyInvasionEvent ...), dead:<hero id>, war:<kingdom>:<kingdom> (at war), own:<settlement>:<kingdom> (held by that realm),
#   rotday:N (days since the story of ROT began - the execution of Ned Stark), prolday:N (days of the prologue; only in a campaign started with it),
#   kr:NNN.w (Chronicle window resolved), kr:NNN.w=x (option x chosen), kr:NNN.w~R (m107: resolved by one of the rows R - 0 = main row, a-z = variant);
#   kr: is false for ever when the Chronicle is off, and a kr: window resolved before the row first appeared in the save does not move it (no side change after the fact).
# action: clan:<clan> lord of that house (may lead a party) | court:<clan> courtier of that house (no party) | lead (may lead a party from now on) |
#   prisoner:<clan or settlement> captive of that house (held in its seat, else in its head's party) or in that keep | free:<clan> set free and back to that house |
#   wander:<culture> leaves his house and wanders a town of that culture (for hire) | remove (gone from the world, no message) |
#   hide[:<end term>] (m105 Chronicle K0: leaves his party and is disabled - alive, back with unhide or when the end term comes true) | unhide[:<settlement>] |
#   die (dies, no message) | marry:<hero id> | wed:<hero id> (marries and joins the spouse's house).
# mode: empty = every campaign, prolog = only a campaign started with the prologue (m101-prolog), classic = only the classic start.
# message: shown to the player only if he knows the character or his realm is one of the two sides; empty = log only.
